name: Bar chart
what: Bars grow from the base one after another with a slow end, each value counting up on its bar; up / down bars in green and red; an optional line drawn across the tops.

learned_from.what: four coloured bars on navy growing one after another, decelerating
the bars one after another and a line drawn over them
gainers up in green, losers down in red, with their values

motion: title 12 f, a bar every 6 f growing 14 f (power3.out) with its value counting, the line 24 f
